systems.system: Plateforme de déclaration électronique de perte de documents
systems.country_label: plateforme de déclaration électronique de perte de documents
systems.platform: developed by the DGSN's own engineers
systems.owner: Direction générale de la Sûreté nationale (national police), under the interior ministry
systems.tiers: online, on the Algerian police's official website; the public declares a lost document remotely; launched 2025-11-27

note: The national police's online platform for declaring lost documents, launched by the interior minister on 27 November 2025 (the DGSN counted 1.3 million loss declarations in 2024 and 1.5 million in 2025 to November): one function only and public-facing, so a systems entry and no fact. It does not say how stations record a report or a case.
